text:
sarah: quick async standup — kernel/batching/KV check-in (what I did / blockers / today)

mike: did — landed batching scheduler tweak (prefer shorter micro-batches for 2048 windows). local p99 down ~12% on small payloads. CI perf job green. :rocket:

raj: did — started KV eviction rewrite, switched to size-based tiers. found a mem growth case when many small seqs are pinned, working on reproducer. blocker: need a reliable repro with workload A to test GC pass.

elaine: did — reviewed mike's batching PR, left 2 small nits (naming + test flake). will merge after CI is green and docs updated. ping @mike for the final rebase.

mike: noted the nits and pushed fix, CI flakes on macOS runner only, retriggered. link to perf diff: https://perf.redwood/example/PR-4322 (internal)

ci-bot: build #4322: all checks passed, benchmarks queued.

raj: repro instructions (local):
```bash
# run workload A for 10m to repro pinned seqs
python -m bench.run --workload A --seed 42 --concurrency 32 --kv-ttl 0
```
observed logs:
```
KVCache: pinned_seq_count=812, mem_mb=18432
kv_gc: skipped_gc_cycle=true reason=pinned_threshold
```

sarah: thanks. raj, can you drop the repro into the shared perf bucket so infra can run on a bigger machine? put it under /shared/bench/repros/raj-kv-2026-03-17.

raj: will do later today. may need a short kernel hotpatch to force full GC for the test.

elaine: blocker from my side — need someone to take ownership of rollout policy for the batching change in Dedicated. ops expects a canary schedule. who can own the rollout docs?

mike: I can draft the rollout steps and the canary metric thresholds. propose: 5% traffic for 2 hours, check p99 and error-rate, then 25% for 1 hour, then 100% if stable.

sarah: fine by me. mike, add the config snippet to the PR description and link the rollout runbook. I'll coordinate with infra for capacity.

mike: ok will add config:```yaml
canary:
  steps:
    - pct: 5
      duration: 2h
    - pct: 25
      duration: 1h
    - pct: 100
      duration: 30m
metrics: ["p99_ms", "error_rate"]
alerts:
  p99_ms: 2.0x baseline
  error_rate: 3x baseline
```

ci-bot: benchmark job #987 queued on perf-large-gpu (ETA ~45m).

sarah: today — i'll chase infra for the perf instance, confirm rollout window, and merge the docs.

raj: today — finish repro upload + try GC hotpatch, then run the repro on perf-large.

mike: today — add rollout snippet to PR, follow up on macOS CI flakes, and monitor benchmark once it completes.

elaine: today — fold the README change into the docs site and remove the TODOs in the PR.

sarah: any quick asks?

mike: pls @sarah if you need me to cut the canary during off-hours. :slightly_smiling_face:

raj: if anyone is free later, i might need help debugging the GC logs — will call it out in #help if so.

sarah: great, thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
